facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition held a validation workshop on 17 June 2026 on the draft national AI roadmap 2026-2030, after drafting it with the private sector, universities, research centres, civil society and the diaspora and collecting contributions from national actors and the diaspora; participants were asked for recommendations (Sidwaya, which also gives 18 June once).

facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition held a national validation workshop on 17 June 2026 at the Virtual University of Burkina Faso where stakeholders from government, the private sector, academia, civil society organisations and technical partners reviewed the draft National AI Roadmap 2026-2030.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition, through SPIVTEN, opened a national situational-analysis workshop on 27 August 2025 for the national AI action plan, bringing together public institutions, the private sector, universities, research centres, civil society and technical and financial partners in thematic sub-groups whose conclusions feed the draft plan.

facts.fact: The Commission du développement durable of Burkina Faso's transitional legislative assembly heard FED-numérique, Internet Society Burkina Faso and two independent ICT specialists on 11 June 2024, and several public bodies on 12 June 2024, on the bill on information systems security, and some of them handed in written observations.
